frames.reason: Directional shadows supply some volume, but pale haze and dark flat faces lack the reference light richness. The restrained palette is too chalky; roofs and ground are mostly uniform fills. Trees remain isolated faceted blobs without natural openings or branch-supported masses.

Basic directional form is visible but illumination feels muted and flat relative to the warm reference. Colour is washed out despite useful autumn accents. Buildings read as simple matte blocks, ground as broad flat fields, and trees as angular single masses rather than organic crowns.

Clear block shadows provide rudimentary form, but shadow and highlight variation lacks the calibrated warmth and depth. Pale colour, nearly uniform roofs and ground, and faceted individual tree lumps give only partial correspondence to the rich stylized target.

Haze creates distance but heavily suppresses colour and form. Foreground trees offer seasonal colour and shading yet remain faceted blobs. Water and park surfaces have little material variation; building volumes and surfaces are simplified and lack the reference depth.

Soft distance falloff is present, but the frame is pale and low in atmospheric colour richness. Materials have limited matte depth and the ground is largely uniform. Tree crowns have some shaded volume but their angular closed masses do not reach the natural branching and openings of the reference.

Sun direction is understandable, with limited light modelling and muted shadow colour. Restrained autumn accents do not offset the washed general palette. Broad ground fills and blocklike buildings lack surface richness; trees remain faceted, closed and repetitive in mass.
